just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gb3 and dwells most on B in Phrase 1. Phrase 5 (0:55.6) introduces Dk, centred on B. Phrase 6 (1:19.5) introduces Db, centred on B. The line peaks at Dk4 (295.7 Hz) at 2:55.0. It closes on the tonic (B3 → B3 → B3 → B3 → B3 → B2).
